target_camera: iPhone 17 Pro / Pro Max (Blackmagic Camera for iOS)
simulation_disclosure: Because native ungraded iPhone 17 Pro Apple Log 2 camera ProRes/HEVC sensor captures are not bundled in this repository, the eight BEFORE test images are documented Simulated Apple Log 2 / Apple Wide Gamut encodings derived mathematically from real daylight and golden-hour photographs. Each source photograph is linearized via inverse IEC 61966-2-1 sRGB EOTF, mapped from display-referred linear to scene-referred linear reflectance via a fixed inverse SDR tone-mapping operator (anchoring 18% middle gray at R=0.18 and restoring natural scene highlight headroom), transformed from linear ITU-R BT.709 (D65) to linear Apple Wide Gamut (D65) using the inverse Normalized Primary Matrix derived from Apple's official Apple Log 2 White Paper (September 2025), and encoded with the official Apple Log 2 transfer function. They do not represent raw iPhone 17 Pro CMOS sensor readout or Apple's proprietary upstream ISP characterization.

technical_references.title: Apple Log 2 White Paper (Part: 028-00834, Version 1.1)
technical_references.author: Apple Inc.
technical_references.verified_facts: Defines Apple Log 2 transfer function (identical to Apple Log Profile: R_0=-0.05641088, R_t=0.01, c=47.28711236, beta=0.00964052, gamma=0.08550479, delta=0.69336945) and Apple Wide Gamut CIE 1931 xy primaries: Red (0.725, 0.301), Green (0.221, 0.814), Blue (0.068, -0.076), White Point D65 (0.3127, 0.3290).

scenes.title: Harsh Midday City
scenes.subtitle: Bright buildings, blue sky and architectural shadows
scenes.source_title: A city street filled with tall buildings and traffic lights
scenes.grading_focus: Controls harsh midday glass and terracotta building reflections, deepens architectural street shadows without crushing, and refines pale cyan-blue sky and street foliage.

scenes.title: Midday Portrait in Direct Sunlight
scenes.subtitle: Natural skin tones, specular sun highlights and crisp facial shadows
scenes.source_title: High-contrast portrait shot in midday sunlight
scenes.grading_focus: Maintains natural, subtly warm golden-peach skin across sunlit and shadowed facial planes, rolls off forehead/cheekbone specular highlights smoothly, and preserves 100% of natural skin pore texture without orange oversaturation or beauty-filter smoothing.

scenes.title: Mediterranean Street
scenes.subtitle: Sunlit limestone masonry, warm timber door, shaded cobblestone alley and azure sky
scenes.source_title: A narrow cobblestone street lined with stone buildings
scenes.grading_focus: Infuses sunlit Mediterranean stone with honey-ochre warmth while keeping open-shade cobblestones dimensional and cool-neutral, preserving natural olive-green courtyard foliage and rich overhead sky.

scenes.title: Bright Beach Daylight
scenes.subtitle: High-albedo white coral sand, shallow coastal water, horizon clouds and midday sky
scenes.source_title: A sandy beach with clear blue water on a sunny day
scenes.grading_focus: Prevents bright midday beach sand from blowing out or turning yellow, preserves subtle warm cream sand texture, controls cyan shallows, and renders the midday sky a deep, natural Mediterranean blue with clean white horizon clouds.

scenes.title: Natural Landscape with Greenery and Mountains
scenes.subtitle: Alpine forest foliage, sunlit meadow, limestone peaks and cumulus clouds
scenes.source_title: Green trees and mountains under blue sky and white clouds during daytime
scenes.grading_focus: Shifts digital yellow-green foliage toward grounded, slightly warm botanical greens with controlled saturation and subtractive density, while maintaining crisp cloud whites and natural mountain atmospheric perspective.

scenes.title: Golden-Hour Landscape
scenes.subtitle: Warm sunset sky and backlit mountain ridges
scenes.source_title: Landscape photography of mountains during golden hour
scenes.grading_focus: Demonstrates golden-hour versatility: self-limiting warm saturation protection prevents already-warm golden-hour skies and backlit ridges from becoming overly orange or clipped, preserving subtle lilac-slate atmospheric haze in the valleys.

scenes.title: Modern Architecture
scenes.subtitle: Brutalist concrete cantilevers, deep geometric shadows, glass reflections and midday sky
scenes.source_title: White concrete building under blue sky during daytime (Geisel Library)
scenes.grading_focus: Renders sunlit concrete with warm architectural stone character while keeping soffit shadows detailed and neutral-deep, avoiding an overall yellow cast on neutral concrete or glass.

scenes.title: Outdoor Travel Scene with People and Buildings
scenes.subtitle: Travelers strolling across Piazza San Marco, Venice in bright midday sunlight
scenes.source_title: Tourists stroll through a sunny European plaza with architecture
scenes.grading_focus: Balances skin tones, white summer dresses, cobalt blue clothing, warm Venetian brick, marble facades, and harsh midday stone paving in a single cohesive luxury Mediterranean travel film aesthetic.
